subject: Deep integration lab — calendar alignment & access checklist
messages:
From: Diana Lowe <diana.lowe@finbridge.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: eng@finbridge.com
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Integration lab request — Redwood console + API

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team liked the performance numbers. We'd like to do a focused integration lab (console walkthrough + API enablement) the week of Nov 9 to validate our CI/CD flow and service account access before the pilot.

High-level asks:
- 90 minute hands-on session for 3 engineers (backend + infra)
- Time to run a short live call to your hosted API and verify token rotation
- Walkthrough of RBAC and audit logs in the console

Do you have availability on Nov 9 or Nov 10? Also let us know any access pre-reqs so our infra team can prepare.

Best,
Diana
Director of Integrations
FinBridge

--
Diana Lowe
FinBridge | integrations@finbridge.com
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Diana Lowe <diana.lowe@finbridge.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Integration lab request — Redwood console + API

Hi Diana — great to hear. Nov 9 works for us; proposing a 90-minute block at 10:00–11:30 PT.

Agenda (proposed):
1) 10:00–10:20 — quick recap & goal alignment
2) 10:20–10:50 — console tour: RBAC, audit logs, rollout controls
3) 10:50–11:20 — API enablement: service account setup, token rotation, example calls
4) 11:20–11:30 — next steps & pilot cadence

Marissa and Dev will lead the console and API portions respectively. Before the session we’ll need:
- A CI runner or laptop with curl/postman and access to FinBridge dev VPC
- Service account email to grant a test role (we’ll share roles table)

I’m attaching an integration checklist and a CSV with recommended role names — please share with your infra folks.

[Attachment: integration-checklist.pdf (application/pdf)]
[Attachment: api-access-roles.csv (text/csv)]

If you prefer a later time on Nov 9 (afternoon PT), tell us and we can adjust.

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference

--
Karthik Iyer
Redwood Inference

Thanks, Karthik — 10:00 PT on Nov 9 is perfect. Quick note: our infra lead, Miguel, will need to attend but he's only available until 11:00 PT. Would you be able to prioritize the token rotation demo and the service account grant earlier in the agenda? If we can run the API calls and token rotation by 10:50 that should work.

Also, is there a recommended IP allowlist step we should prepare? We prefer using a temporary VPN jumpbox for the call.

I'll circulate the service account email tomorrow and confirm participant names.

Best,
Diana

For IP allowlist: we support temporary allowlisting of a single jumpbox IP (please provide its public IP ~24 hours in advance). If you prefer VPN we can accept that too; just make sure the jumpbox routes to our dev endpoints: dev.api.redwood.ai:443.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Marissa
